jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - PHP / JavaScript Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join a long-term project focused on the development, maintenance, and modernization of a large-scale business-critical application ecosystem. The platform handles high volumes of sensitive data, integrates with multiple external systems, and operates in a highly available production environment.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications across the full technology stack.

• Develop and integrate REST APIs.

• Maintain and evolve complex legacy applications while ensuring stability and service continuity.

• Contribute to the migration from legacy technologies (PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, AngularJS, JQuery) towards a modern stack based on PHP 8.2+, Laravel, and Vue.js.

• Improve application architecture, code quality, security, and maintainability.

• Participate in technical analysis, troubleshooting, code reviews, testing, and documentation.

• Collaborate closely with developers, analysts, UX/UI specialists, and project stakeholders within an Agile environment.

Additional information

• Professional English required.

• Long-term assignment with renewable contracts.

• Up to 3 days of remote work per week.

• Occasional on-site visits to operational environments and end users.

• Opportunity to work on applications with direct business impact and visibility.

• Strong experience with PHP and modern JavaScript.

• Solid knowledge of a modern PHP framework (Laravel preferred, Symfony also welcomed).

• Experience with a modern frontend framework (Vue.js is a plus).

• Comfortable working across both backend and frontend development.

• Strong understanding of SQL, REST APIs, GIT, and software development best practices.

• Proven experience maintaining and modernizing legacy applications in production environments.

• Ability to identify and remediate security issues in existing codebases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Technical environment:

• Current stack: PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, Smarty, AngularJS, JQuery

• Target stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12+, Vue 3, JavaScript

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Version Control: GIT / GitLab

• Containers: Docker / Podman

• Operating Systems: Linux / Red Hat Enterprise Linux

• CI/CD: Modern CI/CD practices and tools

Nice to have:

• Experience with Laravel and/or Vue.js.

• Background in application modernization and legacy migration projects.

• Knowledge of application security best practices.

• Experience working on high-availability or mission-critical systems.

• Exposure to Symfony, React, Angular, or similar technologies.

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist Fiber Lasers & Press Brakes - Europe
jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs.

 Job at a glance

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

 
Your new role
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.

You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.

What will you do?

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.
